name: query
description: Answer a natural-language question against a COA namespace with tiered resolution (Tier 1 governed metrics, Tier 2 ontology-guided SQL, Tier 3 agentic fallback). Returns {result, requestId, sessionId}.

query.description: Natural-language question, e.g. 'What is monthly revenue by region?'

execute.description: False = translate only and return the generated query without running it.

tierOverride.description: Pin resolution to tier 1, 2 or 3. Omit for automatic routing.

strategy.description: Tier-2 engine: best, ontop, nl_to_sql, ontop_first, nl_to_sql_first or deep-reasoning.

name: translate_sparql
description: Translate a natural-language question into SPARQL using the namespace's published ontology, without executing it. Returns {sparqlQuery, confidence, trace, ontologyVersion}.

namespaceId.description: The COA namespace whose ontology is used.

name: rag_retrieval
description: Retrieve semantically similar document chunks from the namespace's knowledge base. Returns {chunks, trace, queryEmbeddingModel}.

sourceFilter.description: Restrict to these source document ids.

entityFilter.description: Restrict to chunks annotated with these entities.

name: graph_traversal
description: Traverse the namespace's semantic graph from an entity IRI. Returns {entities, relationships, trace}.

startUri.description: IRI of the entity to start from.
